title: Big Boss's final visit to The Boss's grave in Metal Gear
subject: bigboss
description:
Was Big Boss a hero or a villain? 👇

From a field of white flowers in 1964 to a cemetery in 2014, how Big Boss's story ends. Spoilers for Metal Gear Solid 3 and Metal Gear Solid 4.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Big Boss pulled the trigger in a field of white flowers.
At Rokovoj Bereg, The Boss handed him her gun, the Patriot, and asked him to finish it.
He did. The mission made him a legend and turned him against the country that gave the order.
He built armies of his own, founded Outer Heaven, and ended up fighting his son, Solid Snake.
Fifty years later, in 2014, he walked back to her unmarked grave at Arlington.
He shared one cigar with Solid Snake beside her headstone, and his last words were simple: this is good, isn't it?
